guarantees.claim: Always, in_prd[i] is assigned as the concatenation of out_prd[aes_rot_int(i,4)] (MSBs) and prd_q[WidthPRDSBox*i +: WidthPRDSBox] (LSBs).

Each u_aes_sbox_i instance has en_i connected to (en == SP2V_HIGH), out_ack_i to (out_ack == SP2V_HIGH), op_i to CIPH_FWD, and its outputs wired to sub_word_out_req[i], out_prd[i], sub_word_out[8*i +: 8], and sw_out_mask[8*i +: 8].

assumptions.claim: Function aes_rot_int(i,4) returns a valid index into the out_prd array (0..3).
assumptions.cond: always, when this generate is unrolled
assumptions.risk: If the index is out of bounds, out_prd read yields X, corrupting the randomness mixing and potentially exposing masked values.

assumptions.claim: SP2V_HIGH is defined as 1'b1 and signals en and out_ack are single-bit, so the comparisons produce valid single-bit enables for the S-box.
assumptions.cond: when en or out_ack is used for handshake
assumptions.risk: If SP2V_HIGH is not 1, enable polarity may be inverted; if en/out_ack are multi-bit, the comparison result may be wider than 1 bit, causing width mismatch on u_aes_sbox_i ports and potential X propagation.

assumptions.claim: prd_q has at least WidthPRDSBox*4 bits and a valid slice prd_q[WidthPRDSBox*i +: WidthPRDSBox] exists for all i.
assumptions.risk: Out-of-range bit selection leads to synthesis error or undefined behavior, breaking the masking PRNG contribution and potentially reducing entropy.

assumptions.claim: CIPH_FWD is a valid operation code for the aes_sbox that configures it for forward (SubBytes) operation.
assumptions.risk: If CIPH_FWD selects a wrong or invalid mode, the S-box may output incorrect substitution, corrupting round keys and breaking the cipher.

uncertain_points.claim: The rotation offset aes_rot_int(i,4) is not defined in this chunk; its implementation may not provide sufficient shuffling of out_prd across S-box instances for effective masking.
uncertain_points.cond: when any S-box output is used for randomness mixing
uncertain_points.risk: A weak or predictable rotation pattern could create bias, leak key material, or reduce the effectiveness of the masking countermeasure.

uncertain_points.claim: The comparisons (en == SP2V_HIGH) and (out_ack == SP2V_HIGH) assume single-bit operands; if en or out_ack become multi-bit due to a source coding error, the resulting enable vector may not be properly interpreted by the S-box.
uncertain_points.cond: if the driving logic produces a multi-bit en or out_ack
uncertain_points.risk: The S-box may receive an X or incorrectly sized enable, causing functional failure or meta-stability, which could silently corrupt key expansion outputs.
